Qual depth. Quant scale.
Engage with hundreds of participants online at once and instantly surface the beliefs, motivations, and attitudes driving their choices. Participants vote on each other's responses in real time to uncover hidden insights and reveal consensus for fast yet nuanced audience understanding.
Intentional AI for Intentional Research
Our AI analyzes participant responses instantly, giving you real-time insights so you can adapt, explore deeper, and steer your study as it happens (not just after it ends). You can even use Remy, our embedded AI research assistant, to help handle your study from end-to-end.
Everything you need to run high impact, rapid research.
Our flexible hybrid insights platform adapts to your process, so you can run research your way. Remesh provides the tools and support you need - from our embedded AI research assistant to our white glove research and sample services.

One platform built for how you work.
